files.policies.yml:
version: 1
base_currency: OMR
accounts: [salary, savings, broker, cash]
categories:
  income: [salary, bonus, side]
  expense: [housing, food, transport, family, discretionary, fees]
  transfer: [transfer]
  invest: [buy, sell, dividend]
snapshot_max_age_days: 45
policies:
  - id: FLOOR-H
    type: floor
    title: cash floor
    measure: {holdings: class.cash}
    limit: {value: 1000}
  - id: ALLOC
    type: allocation
    title: cash share
    measure: {share: class.cash}
    band: {min_pct: 50, max_pct: 100}
  - id: K1
    type: kill
    title: broker drawdown
    measure: {drawdown: account.broker, window_days: 90}
    limit: {pct: 50}
  - id: CAP-M
    type: cap
    title: food per month
    measure: {sum: expense.food, period: month}
    limit: {value: 100}
